primary.description: Machine-learning researchers from other subfields (adjacent researchers): know general ML/deep learning, standard Transformer architectures, and standard evaluation practice/statistics, but not speech-processing-specific terminology, datasets, or prior work.
assumed_knowledge: the general idea of zero-shot transfer and distribution shift
standard error-rate style metrics and BLEU-like comparison scores at a conceptual level
scaling-law style plots (performance vs. data/model size)
not_assumed_knowledge: Word Error Rate (WER) computation details and text-normalization conventions
speech-specific datasets (LibriSpeech, Common Voice, Fleurs, VoxPopuli, CoVoST2, TED-LIUM, CHiME, Kincaid46, Earnings-21/22, CORAAL, MLS)
speech-specific baselines (wav2vec 2.0, XLS-R, mSLAM, Maestro, SpeechStew, NVIDIA STT/Conformer-CTC)
conventions of weak/weakly-supervised training data in ASR
voice activity detection (VAD), beam search/temperature-fallback decoding heuristics specific to long-form ASR

secondary.description: Speech/audio-processing specialists reading for context (not the binding persona for density decisions).

tertiary.description: General ML practitioners evaluating whether the approach transfers to their own modality.

term_budget: Define every speech-specific term at first use; no more than ~2 new domain concepts per paragraph.
